messages:
deploy-bot: Release started to eu-west: service/inference v2.30.0 -> v2.31.0 (rollout 10%). commit 9a7b3c. initial canary checks green.

omar: FYI synth health-checks show a brief drift on /health for a subset of hosts ~+80s after rollout. small 500 spikes, not a full outage but p95 increased on canary group.

sre-chi: Looking. Per-host metrics show 500s concentrated on eu-west-node-21 and eu-west-node-23. Host-level CPU/mem normal. Kernel logs show conntrack table nearing high-water mark around the same time.

ops-lee: If conntrack saturation is real we should avoid full rollback. Suggest: 1) pause rollout, 2) evict/quarantine offending hosts from LB, 3) pin eu-west region to stable release until we confirm.

eng-ada: Can we trigger a short host restart instead of quarantine? eviction might be faster via an LB remove + kube drain on the node.

release-maya: Pause rollout now. No further batches.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by release-maya.

ops-lee: Runbook commands (infra-admin):
```bash
# pin region to previous release
routectl set-route --region eu-west --target release:v2.30.0 --weight 100 --reason "post-deploy health-check drift" --expires 60m
# remove hosts from LB
lbctl remove-backend --region eu-west --backend eu-west-node-21
lbctl remove-backend --region eu-west --backend eu-west-node-23
# optional: drain nodes
kubectl drain eu-west-node-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
kubectl drain eu-west-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```

sre-chi: Confirmed conntrack hit: nf_conntrack count peaked at 260k on node-21 (limit=262144). That explains the transient 500s when new connections were dropped.

omar: After LB removal + routing pin, synth errors dropped to baseline within 40s. No customer-facing tickets reported.

product-liz: Thanks. Please add a blurb to the release notes: "eu-west rollout paused after transient health-check errors on two hosts; region routed back to v2.30.0 and hosts quarantined for investigation." I'll prep a customer-safe summary if needed.

eng-ada: Follow-ups: 1) increase conntrack limit in our node bootstrap for next release, 2) add conntrack sampling to canary smoke checks, 3) add a per-host conntrack threshold alarm that auto-evicts a host from LB during rollout. Filing INF-4502.

ops-lee: Applied route change: eu-west -> release:v2.30.0 (effective). Backends removed and node drains started.

deploy-bot: Note added to release timeline: paused at 08:12Z due to host-level conntrack saturation causing transient 500s; diversion applied.

sre-chi: Captured netstat/ss and nf_conntrack dumps for both nodes; attaching to INF-4502 for RCA.

omar: Good catch. Once we have the conntrack increase and a small canary with conntrack sampling, let's re-run during next low-traffic window starting at 02:00 UTC.

release-maya: Marking release as "paused - eu-west reverted" and assigning INF-4502 owner=@eng-ada. Closing thread for now.
